verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs explicitly document exporting and running a dedicated-server build headless, using the `headless` display server and `Dummy` audio driver on machines without a GPU or display server, confirming game logic can run without rendering. This is a first-party, dedicated documentation page for this exact use case, combined with general CLI support for headless operation. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of headless server deployments in production.
